properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 13 at 7:00PM CDT until October 13 at 7:30PM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 700 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
near Lansing to 8 miles west of Linwood, or along a line from near
Lansing to 11 miles southwest of Tonganoxie, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated. This storm has a history of 60 to 70 MPH
winds.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect considerable
tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes,
roofs, and outbuildings.

Locations impacted include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Shawnee, Lenexa, Leawood, Prairie Village,
Merriam, Mission, Bonner Springs, De Soto, Parkville, Tonganoxie,
Basehor, Edwardsville, Fairway, Mission Hills, Riverside, Westwood
and Lake Quivira.
properties.instruction:
Anyone outdoors should move to shelter inside a well-built structure
and stay away from windows. These storms are capable of producing
widespread damaging winds and large hail.

properties.areaDesc: Hemphill, TX; Lipscomb, TX
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 13 at 7:00PM CDT until October 13 at 7:30PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
At 700 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 6 miles northwest of
Higgins, or 8 miles southeast of Lipscomb, moving northeast at 35
mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to roofs, siding, and trees is possible.
People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles.

Locations impacted include...
Lipscomb, Canadian, Higgins, Glazier, and Lake Marvin.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 13 at 6:56PM CDT until October 13 at 8:00PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
SVRAMA

The National Weather Service in Amarillo has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Wheeler County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southeastern Gray County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Collingsworth County in the Panhandle of Texas...
South central Hemphill County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Donley County in the Panhandle of Texas...

* Until 800 PM CDT.

* At 654 PM CDT, a cluster of severe thunderstorms were located in
southern Donley and Collingsworth County and most of Hall County.
Storms are tracking north northeast 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to roofs, siding, and trees is possible.
Hail damage to vehicles is expected.

* Locations impacted include...
Wellington, Clarendon, Shamrock, Briscoe, Wheeler, Mclean, Hedley,
Dodson, Lutie, Lelia Lake, New Mobeetie, Twitty, Allison, Lela,
Quail, Samnorwood, Kellerville, Dozier, and Mobeetie.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with these storms. Move indoors immediately. Lightning
is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear
thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.description:
At 655 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
near Weston to 6 miles north of Edwardsville, or along a line from
near Weston to 6 miles northeast of Basehor, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect considerable
tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes,
roofs, and outbuildings.

Locations impacted include...
Kansas City, Leavenworth, Lansing, Parkville, Platte City, Basehor,
Riverside, Weatherby Lake, Weston, Kansas City Intl Arpt, Kansas
City Kansas, Lake Waukomis, Camden Point, Ferrelview, Platte Woods
and Northmoor.
properties.instruction:
Anyone outdoors should move to shelter inside a well-built structure
and stay away from windows. These storms are capable of producing
widespread damaging winds and large hail.
